entities.summary: Noam Sohlberg is an Israeli jurist who serves as Deputy President of the Supreme Court of Israel since 2025. He has been a justice of the Supreme Court since 2012. He also serves as Chairman of the Central Elections Committee for the elections to the 26th Knesset and as a member of the Judicial Selection Committee. He is considered to be a conservative justice.
